children.text: Participants
ThinkByte: Harsha, Mahesh Patil, Vigarna Ramesh
Key Takeaways

Focus on optimizing social media and marketing strategies, including creating a shared action tracker for social media campaigns, with an emphasis on the "Millet Magic Meal" campaign to boost traffic and engagement.

Decision to continue using audio with integrated music, remove social media from the paid tracker, and set a goal of 400 qualified leads by month-end while aiming to reduce cost per lead below 50 rupees.
Resolved issues included restoration of accidentally deleted action items by Mahesh Patil using edit history and troubleshooting audio problems that affected Harsha and Vigarna Ramesh.
Harsha highlighted the need for regular updates on campaign expenses and lead generation to ensure budget adherence and optimize spending.
Urgent steps to update creative content for current campaigns and schedule a follow-up meeting by the end of September to finalize post scheduling and task completion.
